question: On an STM32F407 with PH10 available in the package, EXTI10 is mapped to PH10 while EXTI2 remains mapped to PA2, but the interrupts do not work correctly. Is this pin combination supported?

generation.answer: No, this pin combination is not supported. According to Page 2 of document RM0090, bits 15:0 of SYSCFG_EXTICR3 must be programmed to the same value to select PH10/PH2 or PI10/PI2 as external interrupt inputs. Since PA2 is already mapped to EXTI2, changing it to PH10 would conflict with the requirement for matching bit values. Therefore, mapping EXTI10 to PH10 and EXTI2 to PA2 simultaneously is not supported.
